specs.description: where define-scope stores a spec: docs/specs files, GitHub issues, or both

replies.description: how the session writes replies: tight drops preamble, recap and filler; standard keeps full prose

rules.tight: Replies are tight: no preamble, recap, filler or hedging. Code, commands, paths, identifiers, error text, numbers, warnings and every not, no, only and except stay whole, and a security warning or a confirmation before an irreversible action is written in full sentences. An output style outranks this.
rules.standard: Replies are standard: full prose. An output style outranks this.

context.description: thousands of tokens a session's context may reach before the next phase of a skill moves to a fresh context

budget.description: normal: every agent dispatch uses the model verify/model-table.json names. lean: an opus agent dispatches on sonnet instead

rules.lean: Budget is lean: when the Task tool dispatches a plugin agent whose entry in verify/model-table.json names model opus, pass sonnet as the Task call's own model parameter instead; an agent named sonnet or haiku there dispatches unchanged.
